levels.name: First Response
levels.conditions: Any service alert or ticket creation

levels.name: Team Lead Escalation
levels.conditions: P1 ticket unresolved after 30 minutes, or network/infrastructure issues

levels.name: Manager Escalation
levels.conditions: P1 ticket unresolved after 1 hour, multiple services affected, or customer impact

rules: Always notify IT Manager for P1 incidents
VPN outages automatically escalate to DevOps Lead
If more than 2 services are down, trigger Level 3 escalation
After-hours P1 incidents: call IT Manager directly
